# ovirt_nic (Data Source)

The ovirt_nic data source returns the details of a network interface attached to a VM by its ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) oVirt ID of the VM the NIC is attached to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the NIC. Either id or name must be specified.
- `name` (String) Name of the NIC. Either id or name must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `mac` (String) MAC address of the NIC.
- `vnic_profile_id` (String) ID of the VNIC profile associated with this NIC.
